verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs say it tracks incremental replication state, so later runs with the same state ID resume where the previous run stopped instead of doing full reloads. That covers the core of the story: state management is handled for you. Missing for 10: detail on how cursors or replication keys are chosen and how changed (not just new) records are detected per connector; independent or hands-on corroboration that incremental syncs work in practice.
